plan_review_history.notes: Replace the generic plan with explicit implementation boundaries and behavioral contracts. Specify typed event/payload models, exact validation rules and limits, source-context serialization, path safety, and stable dict conversion. Specify an atomic inbox repository boundary and failure-quarantine behavior for malformed JSON/schema/unsupported types, including daemon continuation. Specify extraction of task document renderers with daemon compatibility aliases. Name focused tests for valid compatibility, each rejection class, atomic persistence, quarantine, and mixed bad/good cycle processing. Require full unit suite, branch coverage floor, lock check, package build, diff check, Sisyphus verification, GitHub CI, promotion, merge receipt, and close.

Revised implementation plan:
1. Baseline existing queue_conversation, process_inbox_event, run_daemon, task-renderer imports, serialized event shape, and valid feature/issue outputs with focused characterization tests.
2. Add dependency-free frozen dataclass inbox models in domain/inbox/models.py for ConversationEvent, ConversationPayload, ChangedFile, and validation errors. Enforce exact dict/list/str/int/bool types (reject bool as int), explicit field allow-lists, required fields, bounded values, positive max_audit_attempts, non-negative additions/deletions, safe normalized repository-relative paths, and recursively JSON-safe bounded source_context. Keep to_dict output byte-for-byte shape compatible for accepted inputs.
3. Add an infra inbox repository responsible for pending/processing/processed/failed paths, deterministic listing, atomic enqueue via existing write_json_file, claiming, and terminal moves. Preserve legacy file naming and directory layout.
4. Refactor daemon queue/process paths to parse and validate through the models/repository. Catch decode, schema, unsupported-type, and processing exceptions per event; persist normalized failure metadata, quarantine the file, increment failed, publish/log once, and continue processing subsequent events. Preserve public dict return values and supported-event behavior.
5. Extract feature/issue BRIEF and PLAN rendering plus shared helpers into domain/task/documents.py. Re-export existing underscored daemon symbols so existing imports/tests remain valid.
6. Add tests covering accepted event round trips and output compatibility; unknown/missing/wrong-type/oversized/path-traversal/non-JSON rejection; atomic enqueue; malformed JSON/schema/unsupported quarantine; bad-then-good cycle continuation; terminal file placement; and daemon renderer aliases.
7. Run targeted tests, full unittest suite, branch coverage >=80%, uv lock --check, offline package build, git diff --check, Sisyphus verify, GitHub CI, PR merge, merge receipt, and close. No new runtime dependency and no unrelated CLI restructuring.

Approved against the explicit seven-step revised scope recorded in the plan revision: strict typed contracts, atomic inbox repository, per-event quarantine and continuation, task-document extraction with compatibility aliases, focused regression tests, and full promotion verification. User explicitly directed complete execution.
